page_title: KOR 2-1 CZE | South Korea v Czech Republic 12/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Gi-Hyuk Lee (South Korea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Amin Omar had an easy-decision to make.
90+5' Tomas Chory (Czech Republic) was too forceful with his tackle and Amin Omar interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90+4' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
90+4' Jin-Gyu Kim (South Korea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

90+3' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Seung-Gyu Kim anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
90+1' Amin Omar blows for a foul after Robin Hranac (Czech Republic) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Hee-Chan Hwang (South Korea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
86' The attendance for today's match is 44985.
85' The referee blows his whistle as Han-Beom Lee (South Korea) was too aggressive in his challenge.
84' Today's match ends for Alexandr Sojka who will be replaced by Mojmir Chytil (Czech Republic).
84' Myung-Bo Hong has decided to make a change. Jin-Seob Park (South Korea) replaces Seung-Ho Paik.
84' A substitution has been made. In-Beom Hwang goes off and Jin-Gyu Kim (South Korea) comes on.
83' Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
82' Adam Hlozek (Czech Republic) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Seung-Gyu Kim pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
80' 2 - 1 Goal! In-Beom Hwang puts a cross into the box and finds Hyeon-Gyu Oh (South Korea), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the middle of the net. He makes it 2:1.
79' Celebrations are cut short for Czech Republic as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
78' Wait! Referee Amin Omar has indicated he is going to review the Czech Republic goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

77' Tomas Soucek (Czech Republic) celebrates a stunning goal. He manages to win himself just enough space to meet the resulting set piece inside the box and produces a perfect header into the top of the net.
76' Han-Beom Lee (South Korea) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick to Czech Republic.
76' Czech Republic control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
74' It looks like Ladislav Krejci (Czech Republic) saw red with that tackle. Amin Omar won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
74' Stepan Chaloupek (Czech Republic) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
70' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
69' Myung-Bo Hong decides to make a substitution. Heung-Min Son will be replaced by Hyeon-Gyu Oh (South Korea).
69' Substitution. Tae-Seok Lee (South Korea) makes way for Ji-Sung Eom.
67' 1 - 1 GOAL! In-Beom Hwang (South Korea) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over Matej Kovar, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 1:1.
66' South Korea are seeing far more of the ball now.
64' Miroslav Koubek prepares a substitution. Lukas Provod is replaced by Michal Sadilek (Czech Republic).
64' It is time for a substitution. Tomas Chory (Czech Republic) is on for Patrik Schick.
64' Miroslav Koubek has decided to substitute Pavel Sulc and he is replaced by Adam Hlozek (Czech Republic).
63' Ladislav Krejci (Czech Republic) makes a rough challenge and Amin Omar blows his whistle for a foul.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jae-Sung Lee leaves the pitch and Hee-Chan Hwang (South Korea) comes on.
62' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
61' Kang-In Lee (South Korea) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
59' 0 - 1 GOAL! Ladislav Krejci (Czech Republic) rises to meet a long throw in and plants a glorious header past Seung-Gyu Kim from close range. The score changes to 0:1.
58' Jaroslav Zeleny (Czech Republic) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
58' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
56' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

56' The ball goes out of play. South Korea are awarded a corner kick. Heung-Min Son (South Korea) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Matej Kovar anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
54' South Korea are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
53' Tomas Soucek (Czech Republic) commits a rough foul. Amin Omar stops the game and makes a call.
50' 10:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.

49' Jae-Sung Lee (South Korea) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.

49' In-Beom Hwang (South Korea) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Matej Kovar is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
48' The corner kick from Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
48' The ball is cleared after Pavel Sulc (Czech Republic) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The referee blows his whistle, Czech Republic are awarded a corner kick.
47' Dangerous play by Min-Jae Kim (South Korea). Amin Omar blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+3' Wasted opportunity! In-Beom Hwang (South Korea) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
45+2' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Amin Omar has a clear sight and sees a foul from Robin Hranac (Czech Republic).
42' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
42' The free kick is delivered by Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
41' In-Beom Hwang (South Korea) brings an opponent down and Amin Omar interrupts the game. Czech Republic have a free kick.
40' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Amin Omar no option but to blow his whistle.
39' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
38' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) receives the ball and has a go from distance, but he shouldn't have bothered as it sails high over the bar.
37' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
34' Tae-Seok Lee (South Korea) makes a strong challenge and Amin Omar blows for a foul.
34' Tae-Seok Lee (South Korea) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
33' Tomas Soucek (Czech Republic) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
32' Pavel Sulc (Czech Republic) attempts a long-range volley towards the goal, but misses the target.
31' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 52:48.
29' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Amin Omar who sees an offensive foul.
28' Alexandr Sojka (Czech Republic) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.

28' Han-Beom Lee (South Korea) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Amin Omar has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Czech Republic, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
26' Young-Woo Seol (South Korea) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
23' The referee blows for a cooling break.
23' Amin Omar blows his whistle. Lukas Provod (Czech Republic) commits a foul after dangerous play.
22' Tomas Soucek (Czech Republic) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
22' Alexandr Sojka (Czech Republic) will take a corner kick.
21' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Good work from Czech Republic as they win a corner.
21' The corner from Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) is cleared away by the defence.
21' Tomas Soucek (Czech Republic) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball goes out of play and Czech Republic have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Min-Jae Kim (South Korea) commits a rough challenge and Amin Omar blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Lukas Provod (Czech Republic) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
17' Kang-In Lee (South Korea) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Czech Republic.
16' Pavel Sulc (Czech Republic) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Amin Omar blows for a foul. South Korea have a free kick.
16' Vladimir Coufal (Czech Republic) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

15' Patrik Schick (Czech Republic) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Czech Republic will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
14' Kang-In Lee (South Korea) takes a short corner kick.

14' A neat pass finds Kang-In Lee (South Korea) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Matej Kovar denies him with a good save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to South Korea.
12' Han-Beom Lee (South Korea) latches on to a sweet cross inside the box and misses with a header high above the bar.
12' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

12' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for South Korea.
11' Kang-In Lee (South Korea) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
9' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
8' Amin Omar couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Ladislav Krejci (Czech Republic) and blew his whistle. South Korea earn a free kick.
6' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jae-Sung Lee (South Korea).
5' South Korea enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' Heung-Min Son (South Korea) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
2' Ladislav Krejci (Czech Republic) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
